original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: upper jaw projecting far beyond the lower jaw.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：远超下颌向前伸出的上颌。

scale.basis: 385cm and97mm humerus are documented. Skull/jaw/paddle dimensions are approximate proportions interpreted from central skeleton photo, which has perspective distortion and no internal metricbar. Flesh width and thickness are conservative inference. These secondary values are not specimen caliper measurements.

uncertainty: R5465 is a compressed mounted skeleton, not an intact living contour. Living tissue thickness, dorsalfin and upper caudalfin margins, exactskin pattern, external eye shape and swimming pose are reconstructions.
Taxonomic debate retained at specieslevel without changing genus. Do not mix E.mistelgauensis body estimates intoR5465.
No four-angle realphoto set exists here. Standard four renders inspect a bounded3D interpretation supported by real specimen plus primary literature, notphotogrammetry.

Mounted skeletal curvature or preparatory replacements cannot be treated as exact livingtail outline. Buchholtz2001 flags altered fluke orientation in anotherGPIT specimen and dubious authenticity of SMNS14931; neither becomes exactgeometry anchor.
